_comment: Tier-2 for fenics eigenvalue#4: the two corrections to the Dirichlet mass matrix recipe. (1) `diag=0.0` on B does NOT work with the default spectral transform. The default EPS transform is a plain shift, which factorises B itself, and the zeroed constrained rows are an exact zero pivot. Wrong variant: B assembled with bcs and diag=0.0 and no ST set. Right variant: the same matrices with eps.getST().setType(SLEPc.ST.Type.SINVERT). (2) Assembling B with `bcs=[]` is NOT a clean substitute. With a CONSISTENT mass matrix the boundary-to-interior blocks are non-zero, so it solves a different pencil. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 on dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
